title: A Different Kind of Beginning

shots.image: the lesson notebook closing on the desk, warm afternoon light, close view

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Life moved forward, and marriage brought a new home, new relationships and new responsibilities.

shots.image: a graceful Indian Muslim nikah in a courtyard with string lights, roses and jasmine, {BRIDE} sitting modestly beside {GROOM}, family around, seen from behind
shots.motion: fairy lights twinkle, family members smile
shots.sfx: soft crowd murmur, bangles, gentle laughter, no music

shots.image: {WIFE} arriving at {NEW_HOME} carrying a suitcase, looking around, seen from behind
shots.sfx: door opening, footsteps, suitcase wheels, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I was learning to adjust, to manage a home and to understand a new phase of life.

shots.image: {IN_LAW} welcoming {WIFE} in the living room of {NEW_HOME}, side view
shots.motion: she places a hand on her shoulder

shots.image: {WIFE} smiling and nodding to {IN_LAW}, side view

lines.speaker: WOMAN
lines.text: Yes, Alhamdulillah. I'm slowly settling in.

shots.image: {WIFE} busy in the kitchen of {NEW_HOME} cooking and arranging steel containers, side view
shots.sfx: utensils, sizzling pan, footsteps, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: My professional dreams slowly moved into the background.

shots.image: a wooden shelf holding her teaching books and lesson notebook, {WIFE}'s hand gently touching the spines, close view
shots.motion: her fingers rest on the books
shots.sfx: quiet room, clock ticking, no music

shots.image: {WIFE} at the balcony of {NEW_HOME} at night looking at the moon over the trees, seen from behind
shots.motion: her dupatta moves in the breeze

lines.speaker: WOMAN_SOFT
lines.text: One day, I'll return to my dreams.

shots.image: {WIFE} on the balcony at dawn watching birds fly over green trees, seen from behind

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Somewhere inside me, the girl who wanted to achieve something was still waiting for her moment.

shots.image: {WIFE}'s hands gently holding a pair of tiny baby shoes in a newly arranged child's room with a wooden crib
shots.motion: she places the shoes beside the crib
